name: Predict keys
description: A phone keyboard pops up over the shot and types a word letter by letter. Each tapped key pops up, the three suggestions change with every letter, and the last tap picks a suggestion: the word lands in gold and the suggestions guess the next word. Then the keyboard drops away.
when: When you name a thing, a tool or the next topic: the keyboard types it, and the next-word guesses can tease what comes next.
needs: the word to type, and the text before it
the cut time where it starts
